svg.title: Hyper-Connections reports 1.8 times faster convergence for one evaluated configuration.
svg.desc: A relative bar chart comparing training steps needed to reach the same validation metric: the baseline ResNet needs about 1.8 times as many steps as the OLMoE-1B-7B DHC times 4 Hyper-Connections configuration, which is set to 1.0 as the reference.
